notes: Shipping: several orders for one customer go in one box with one label, and tracking reaches every order in the box. After a buy the Ship page stays on the label and prints it to your printer on its own, with a Settings switch that is on by default. A shipped order opens as a Shipped screen with Reprint label, Open label PDF, Refresh tracking and Refund label, and Ship again after a refund. Insurance shows after the buy, and the handle plus real name show on the shipping side only. Every label you buy files its postage and insurance as a shipping expense, and a refund takes it back. Live Desk: an Open tab and a Paid tab. A paid, held or shipped bag moves to Paid, newest first, with a Ship link on each. Fixes: no window flashes when a label prints, and an order the cloud already removed leaves your list on delete every time.
